text:
mira: Hey all, day 1 questionI can view Feature Flags in console.staging but when I try to edit a flag the UI shows "You don't have permission to modify this flag". Any idea which permission controls edits?
oscar: welcome! Editing needs console.flag.write. Viewing is console.flag.read. Did you get the staging edit role?
mira: Okta shows I'm in staging-access and the app says groups synced. No explicit "edit" role visible.
devex-bot: Short-lived write access can be requested via /grant-jit staging-flag-edit --user mira --ttl 2h. Approvers: infra, oscar.
oscar: I started a JIT approval; while that processes you can try rwctl for scripted changes if you have a service token. Example: 

rwctl flags update --env staging --flag beta-payment --rollout 10% --actor mira --reason "onboard smoke"

mira: I don't have a service token yet. Tried the JIT but still blocked.
infra-oncall: Checking mappings  looks like the Okta->RBAC mapping for group "eng-staging-flag-editors" was not included in the staging mapping set. Pushing fix and re-running sync.
infra-oncall: Sync complete; mapping added: Okta eng-staging-flag-editors -> console.flag.write.
mira: refreshed and I can now edit flags in the UI :tada:
mira: a couple notes for the onboarding doc: 1) edits require console.flag.write 2) if UI is blocked, try JIT or rwctl once you have a token 3) prod edits are restricted, follow runbook and get cross-team signoff
rowan: adding: prod flips need runbook + at least one approver from product-ops. Also always include a reason in rwctl for audit.
oscar: thanks for the doc notes, mira. Can you drop them into /handbook/onboarding-flags.md?
mira: will add a short section and include the rwctl example. Thanks everyone!
